projects.title: Unity Sports Club Dashboard
projects.description: A production-grade, multi-role sports club management dashboard built with advanced React patterns, reusable component systems, and optimized state management.
projects.longDescription: A full-featured sports club management dashboard built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS — used as a personal playground to learn by building. Features role-based routing and auth for Admin, Manager, Player, and Umpire roles. Admin manages the entire app including users, tournaments, applications, schedules, matches, results, venues, and news. Managers handle team creation, player management, playing squads, and tournament applications. Players and Umpires can create accounts, build profiles, and access read-only views. Built with a feature-based folder structure and advanced React design patterns including compound composition, strategy pattern, container-presenter, HOFs, and custom hooks. All reusable components are hand-crafted using CVA and cn utilities. Forms built with React Hook Form and Zod, rich text with Tiptap, and flexible tables with TanStack Table. Uses RTK Query for data fetching, Sentry for error monitoring, and manual code splitting for optimized performance.
features: Role-based routing and auth — Admin, Manager, Player, Umpire with scoped access and CRUD
Admin panel: user management, tournaments, applications, schedules, matches, results, venues, and news
Manager panel: team creation, player add/remove, playing squad builder, tournament application
Flexible TanStack Table with sorting, filtering, and pagination
Custom reusable component system — Input, PasswordInput, EmailInput, DateInput, TextInput and more
Rich text editing with Tiptap, forms with React Hook Form + Zod validation
Error monitoring with Sentry and manual chunk-based code splitting
Theme switching (Light/Dark/System), loading skeletons, and full responsive design
challenges: Designing a scalable, reusable component system from scratch using CVA and cn without a UI library
Implementing complex role-based routing and scoped access for 4 different user types
Manual code splitting and chunk size optimization to improve initial load performance
Managing server state, caching, and synchronization efficiently with RTK Query
Building a flexible TanStack Table system that works across many different data shapes
Structuring a large React codebase with feature-based architecture and keeping it maintainable
Handling error boundaries and loading states consistently across the entire app
Integrating Tiptap rich text editor with React Hook Form and Zod validation
learnings: Advanced React design patterns: compound composition, strategy, container-presenter, HOF, custom hooks, and props drilling alternatives (Context / composition)
Hand-built reusable component library using CVA and cn — inputs, buttons, cards, modals, tables
Flexible form system with React Hook Form, Zod schema validation, and field-level component breakdown
Powerful data tables with TanStack Table — sortable, filterable, paginated
Rich text editor integration using Tiptap React
Feature-based folder structure for scalable, maintainable architecture
RTK Query for efficient server state, caching, and data fetching
Manual code splitting and lazy loading for performance optimization
Error monitoring in production using Sentry
Role-based access control with protected routing
TypeScript for type-safe, self-documenting code
Fully responsive, polished UI with dark/light/system theme support

projects.title: Unity Sports Club Backend API
projects.description: A scalable RESTful backend API for managing a sports club, built with Express, TypeScript, and MongoDB — covering 100+ endpoints, 18 data models, and production-level concerns like caching, logging, and transactions.
projects.longDescription: This backend powers the Unity Sports Club system, built as a personal learning project to go deep into real-world backend engineering. Started from requirements analysis and problem finding, then moved to ERD-based schema design with proper relations and normalization. Built 100+ RESTful endpoints across 18 interconnected Mongoose models using a feature-based modular routing structure. Implemented role-based auth (Admin, Manager, Player, Umpire) with JWT and bcrypt. Applied query optimizations like .lean(), field selection, .exists() for existence checks, and MongoDB transactions with rollback for data integrity. Added middleware-based Redis caching (moderate level), API timeout handling, structured logging with Pino, and file uploads via Multer and Cloudinary. Solved real deployment challenges including CORS issues. Documented the project with an ERD diagram and project flow structure showing how all pieces wire together.
features: 100+ RESTful API endpoints across users, teams, players, tournaments, matches, venues, and blogs
18 fully designed and interconnected Mongoose data models with ERD documentation
Role-based access control — Admin, Manager, Player, Umpire — with JWT and bcrypt
MongoDB transactions with rollback for data integrity across related operations
Middleware-based Redis caching for optimized repeated data fetching
Optimized queries using .lean(), field selection, and .exists() for performance
Structured logging with Pino and API timeout handling for production reliability
File uploads via Multer and Cloudinary with secure access control
Feature-based modular routing for scalable and maintainable architecture
Project flow and ERD diagram documenting system structure and data relationships
challenges: Requirements analysis and problem finding before writing a single line of code
Designing a normalized ERD with 18 models and complex cross-feature relationships
Implementing MongoDB transactions and rollback for multi-step operations
Setting up middleware-based Redis caching without over-engineering
Solving CORS issues in deployment environment
Balancing query performance with .lean(), .exists(), and field projection at scale
Structuring a large backend cleanly with feature-based routing and reusable middleware
learnings: Requirements analysis, problem scoping, and planning before implementation
Database schema design with ERD, normalization, and relationship mapping
Query optimization — .lean(), field selection, .exists(), and aggregation
MongoDB transactions with rollback for atomic multi-document operations
Middleware-based Redis caching (moderate level) for performance
Structured production logging with Pino
API timeout handling and error middleware for reliability
Feature-based modular routing for large-scale Express apps
Role-based auth with JWT and bcrypt across multiple user types
Debugging and solving real deployment issues like CORS
Documenting systems with ERD diagrams and project flow structures

projects.title: Unity Arena
projects.description: A dynamic, responsive public-facing landing page for the sports club, showcasing live stats, tournaments, teams, and news.
projects.longDescription: This landing page provides fans and visitors with an interactive, fast-loading experience to follow tournaments, view team and player profiles, check live scores, and read news updates. Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Aceternity UI, it leverages React Query for efficient data fetching and state management, ensuring real-time updates and smooth UX.
features: Dynamic display of tournaments, matches, and upcoming events
Team and player profiles with relevant stats
News/blog highlights and announcements
Live scores and standings using React Query for real-time data fetching
Responsive and polished UI using Tailwind CSS and Aceternity UI components
Performance optimization with lazy loading and code splitting
challenges: Fetching and displaying live data efficiently using React Query
Ensuring seamless performance and fast page loads
Designing a responsive and engaging UI for mobile and desktop
Integrating Aceternity UI components consistently with Tailwind CSS
learnings: Advanced data fetching and caching with React Query
Building responsive landing pages with Next.js and Tailwind CSS
Integrating pre-built UI component libraries (Aceternity UI) into custom design
Performance optimization techniques for modern frontend apps
Creating engaging, user-friendly public-facing interfaces
